profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat
profile.summary: Open source enthusiast with a passion for pursuing a deep understanding of the latest solutions and platforms in cloud computing and automation.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading Helm chart software certification development efforts and partner relations.
- Maintaining container and Kubernetes Operator certification tooling, pipelines, and partner relations.
- Enabling engineering partners familiarizing and developing for OpenShift Virtualization

positions.title: Sr. Service Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborate with software vendors to provide a seamless experience integrating their solutions into Kubernetes through the use of Operators.
- Develop Kubernetes operator best practices and facilitate the improvement of the operator-framework and operator ecosystem.
- Explore operator use cases and simplify the integration of software solutions into Kubernetes.
- Develop and maintain CI Pipelines and tooling for ISV solutions delivered via Helm, Operators, and containers.

positions.title: OpenStack Private Cloud Engineer I
positions.description:
- Support OpenStack cloud infrastructure and troubleshoot critical components to promote infrastructure and API uptime
- Advise and facilitate customer workloads and encourage cloud computing practices for better customer experience.
- Identify, codify, and report bugs and issue in infrastructure services causing impact to production workloads to upstream projects for resolution
- Document processes and procedures to ensure repeatable outcomes in implementation of customization or configuration preferences.

positions.title: OpenStack Administrator
positions.description:
- Prepare, Deploy and Configure Scalable OpenStack-Based Clouds using the OpenStack-Ansible project's deployment strategy on Ubuntu LTS Releases. 
- Prepare and deploy additional resources (compute, storage, etc.) for on-demand scaling of OpenStack-based clouds
- Take full advantage of containerization technologies for high-availability of OpenStack APIs and resources.

positions.title: Application Quality Assurance
positions.description:
- Generating bug reports that are clear and concise to be sent to programmers for patching (including necessary steps for reproduction of said bugs or issues). 
- Testing and retesting of key features. Sending new feature options to project manager for consideration and implementation.

certifications.name: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA, RHEL 9)
certifications.title: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA, RHEL 9)
